summary: Jiuzi Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) for the period ended April 30, 2026. The filing contains unaudited interim financial statements and discloses supplier and customer concentration risks, share-based compensation, warrant issuances, and private placement transactions from prior periods. No agreement or event involving an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, delisting, or other special situation is indicated. This is a routine periodic report of financial results and ordinary capital markets activity, not a special-situation event.
